== Template:Item/ClassRestrictions ==

Displays which classes can equip this item.

=== Parameters ===

All parameters are optional. Set to any value to show that class.

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Description
|-
| '''arcanist''' || Set to any value to show "Arcanist"
|-
| '''druid''' || Set to any value to show "Druid"
|-
| '''paladin''' || Set to any value to show "Paladin"
|-
| '''reaver''' || Set to any value to show "Reaver"
|-
| '''stormcaller''' || Set to any value to show "Stormcaller"
|-
| '''duelist''' || Set to any value to show "Windblade"
|}

=== Example ===

'''Code:'''
<pre>
{{Item/ClassRestrictions
|arcanist=yes
|druid=yes
|stormcaller=yes
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{Item/ClassRestrictions
|arcanist=yes
|druid=yes
|stormcaller=yes
}}
